exposure: Maternal demographics (ethnic distribution, substance use, educational attainment, maternal BMI)
ART regimens (e.g., integrase strand transfer inhibitors)
cohort: The study included 318 pregnant women living with HIV from 2000-2010 and 140 from 2011-2021, who received care at a tertiary center in Barcelona.
finding: While maternal and perinatal outcomes in pregnant women living with HIV improved over two decades, high rates of adverse perinatal outcomes related to placental dysfunction (SGA, preeclampsia) persisted.
mod_finding: Obstetric management evolved, with a significant rise in vaginal deliveries from 24.8% to 44.3% between the two study periods.
birth_weight: Small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants were an outcome measured.
gest_age: Preterm birth rates and small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants were outcomes measured.
